scope: Isolated synthetic workspace; real Supabase auth, RLS and RPCs; channel and reservation providers are simulated. Email delivery is not exercised.

Staff cannot promote their own role

Owner promotion gives manager rights and retains owner protection

Guest records merge only with explicit consent and retain history
